description: A security vulnerability has been detected in YunaiV ruoyi-vue-pro up to 2025.09. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /crm/contract/transfer. The manipulation of the argument id/newOwnerUserId leads to improper authorization. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading the affected component is advised. The vendor confirms: "[T]he current code already checks the functional update permission, uses the authenticated server-side user ID, requires CRM OWNER permission, and explicitly rejects non-owner transfers in the shared transfer service, except for authorized CRM administrators."
